page.overview:
Who is Anquipanqui?

Anquipanqui is one of the five green-crested Skink priests known as "High Skinks" who assisted the Slann Xtli in his divinations during the arrival of the Tilean explorer Marco Colombo on the continent of Lustria on the fifteenth day after the zenith of the Itchli Star, as foretold in the prophecy of Zhocl-Tlapoc.

Itzi-Tepl and the other green-crested High Skinks Mancixapati, Ylopulqua, Manquoxutni and Dotpechuini were his equals in this task.
